_comment: Every HTTP endpoint the Trimio backend mounts, harvested from backend/server.js and backend/routes/*.js (including routers nested through router.use and the three reached via normalizeRouter inside if-blocks). This is the contract the API, security and performance suites iterate: a route that appears here and is not covered is a gap the coverage report names. Regenerate with scripts/harvest_api.py after any backend routing change.

_guards.PUBLIC: no authentication middleware - reachable by anyone
_guards.STAFF: requireStaff - admin, super admin and support tiers 5-8
_guards.SUPER_ADMIN: adminAuth + requireSuperAdmin - the single super-admin seat only

_observedNote: 'observed' holds the status codes a live sweep on 2026-09-21 got for [anon, client, professional, vendor, admin, superAdmin] on the parameterless GETs. It is evidence, not an expectation: the suites assert the guard, not these numbers.
